indication.text: GILENYA is indicated for the treatment of patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS) to reduce the frequency of clinical exacerbations and to delay the accumulation of physical disability.

citations.quote: GILENYA is indicated for the treatment of patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS) to reduce the frequency of clinical exacerbations and to delay the accumulation of physical disability.

target_moa.text: Fingolimod is metabolized to the active metabolite fingolimod-phosphate, a sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor modulator that binds S1P receptors 1, 3, 4 and 5 and blocks the capacity of lymphocytes to egress from lymph nodes, reducing peripheral blood lymphocytes.

citations.quote: Fingolimod is metabolized by sphingosine kinase to the active metabolite, fingolimod-phosphate. Fingolimod-phosphate is a sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor modulator, and binds with high affinity to sphingosine 1-phosphate receptors 1, 3, 4, and 5. Fingolimod-phosphate blocks the capacity of lymphocytes to egress from lymph nodes, reducing the number of lymphocytes in peripheral blood.

modality.text: Small molecule (orally active sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor modulator)

citations.quote: FTY720 is an orally active first in class, sphingosine 1 phosphate (S1P) receptor modulator.

detail.text: A REMS was required, consisting of a Medication Guide, a communication plan, and a timetable for submission of assessments, to ensure the benefits outweigh the risk of bradyarrhythmia and atrioventricular block at treatment initiation, infections, macular edema, respiratory effects, hepatic effects, and fetal risk.

citations.quote: In accordance with section 505-1 of FDCA, we have determined that a REMS is necessary for GILENYA (fingolimod) to ensure that the benefits of the drug outweigh the risk of bradyarrhythmia and atrioventricular block at treatment initiation, infections, macular edema, respiratory effects, hepatic effects, and fetal risk.
The REMS consists of a Medication Guide, a communication plan, and a timetable for submission of assessments of the REMS.

vote.text: The Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee voted unanimously that there was substantial evidence of effectiveness in reducing relapses in RRMS, voted 24-1 for substantial evidence in delaying accumulation of physical disability, and voted unanimously that the safety data for 0.5 mg daily justified approval.

citations.quote: 1) The committee voted unanimously that there was substantial evidence of effectiveness for fingolimod in reducing the incidence of relapses in patients with RRMS, and voted 24-1 that there was substantial evidence of effectiveness in delaying the accumulation of physical disability in these patients.
The committee voted unanimously that the safety data for 0.5 mg daily justified approval, and also voted unanimously that patients should receive the first dose in a monitored setting.

summary.text: As the first oral MS treatment NDA, Gilenya was granted Fast Track status (IND fast track June 7, 2007) and priority review (February 18, 2010), was discussed at the Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee (June 10, 2010), and was approved with a REMS; it was not an accelerated approval.
